explication: Swift Collections is a Swift library of data structures, not an application with a single user-to-result pipeline. A Swift client imports modules and uses their collection APIs; the README documents the principal structure families and their semantics. The graph groups those APIs by purpose and includes the combined-import and experimental container interfaces. Some documented capabilities have no corresponding source path in the supplied tree, so their paths are left null; wiring between individual implementations is omitted where sampled source does not establish it.
